title: ARMD-Predict: multi-site machine learning to predict antibiotic resistance before culture results
abstract: arXiv:2610.32998v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinicians select empiric antibiotics before culture susceptibility results are available. Electronic health record (EHR) models could inform that choice, but most are developed at a single hospital and transport poorly to others. We developed ARMD-Predict using 7.5 million culture-antibiotic observations from four academic medical centers. One set of models estimates susceptibility to individual antibiotics; a second, hierarchical set predicts the infecting organism and then organism-specific resistance phenotypes. Across 23 pooled susceptibility models evaluated in same-period, patient-grouped test partitions, median area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) was 0.77 for inpatient urine and 0.70 for inpatient blood cultures; chronological retraining reduced AUROC by approximately 0.04. translated_title: ARMD-Predict：在培养结果得出前预测抗生素耐药性的多中心机器学习模型
translated_abstract: 临床医生在培养药敏结果出来之前就需要选择经验性抗生素。电子健康记录（EHR）模型可以为这一选择提供参考，但大多数模型是在单一医院开发的，向其他机构迁移的效果较差。我们利用来自四个学术医疗中心的750万条培养-抗生素观测数据开发了ARMD-Predict。其中一组模型估计对单个抗生素的敏感性；另一组建分层模型先预测感染病原体，再预测病原体特异性的耐药表型。在同期、按患者分组的测试分区中评估的23个汇总敏感性模型中，住院患者尿液培养的ROC曲线下面积（AUROC）中位数为0.77，住院患者血培养为0.70；按时间顺序重新训练使AUROC下降约0.04。在95%阳性预测值的探索性阈值下（在同一测试观测数据上推导和评估），该模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于四个学术医疗中心的750万条培养-抗生素数据构建了多中心机器学习模型ARMD-Predict，能够在培养药敏结果出来之前预测抗生素耐药性，为经验性抗生素选择提供跨机构可迁移的决策支持。
en_tdlr: ARMD-Predict is a multi-site machine learning framework trained on 7.5 million culture-antibiotic observations from four academic medical centers that predicts antibiotic resistance before culture results are available, enabling better-informed empiric antibiotic selection with improved cross-institutional transportability.
